headline: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services announces second stock option grant
summary: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the second grant of options under its Employees Stock Options Scheme (ESOP) 2025. Such grants are typically used by companies to incentivize and retain key personnel. While the issuance adds to potential future equity dilution, it is a standard corporate governance and HR procedure for listed firms. Indian retail investors should note that routine ESOP grants have a minimal immediate impact on the stock price or financial performance.
why_it_matters: Routine ESOP issuance causes negligible immediate impact for shareholders
